listing.name: Goldilocks Star System v0.5.1
listing.summary: Adds a pre-generated, vanilla-compliant star system with a yellow star, multiple planets, a gate, and early-game facilities.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a pre-generated, vanilla-compliant star system with a yellow star, multiple planets, a gate, and early-game facilities.

description:
Goldilocks Star System (0.98a)(0.5.1)

(0.95.1a version here)

Tired of resetting for the perfect(ish) star system for your (mostly) vanilla game?

Want a system that can serve as your base right from the get go?

Want something that's good, but not overpowered and perfectly compliant with a vanilla experience?

Lucky you! I've got just the place!

Just south of the core worlds you'll find the Goldilocks system.

Prepped for human habitation by the Domain just before the gate system collapse...

And (somehow) completely ignored and forgotten about since!

Should be fully compatible with

random Core worlds

and avoid any planets overlapping.

Please let me know otherwise!

Featuring:

A yellow star;A hot barren world with no atmosphere;A terran paradise world with bountiful farmland;A toxic world rich in all ores and plentiful organics;An icy gas giant with plentiful volatiles;A gate;A trio of Domain-era devices populating the stable locations;An abandoned pet station, for all your early game storage needs;A lovingly crafted system that's as pretty as it is practical;

Pictures

SpoilerTo be retaken.

[close]

Mod requirements:

None!

Mod compatibility:

Everything, in theory.

So long as another mod doesn't inject a star system in the same place as this one, it should work.

Disclaimer:

This is my first mod, any helpful insights and feedback are super appreciated!

The system should have everything needed to form a vertical empire and can benefit from all industry items.

SpoilerEverything about Goldilocks was built with Starsector's own system generation rules in mind, as far as I could extrapolate from quick reviews of the decompiled code. From the star's and planet's sizes and approximate orbits to the latter's market conditions were built using the game's proc_gen csv files as reference for available values and market conditions. In theory, given enough time and luck, it should be possible to procedurally generate a system almost identical to it.[close]

aiDescription: Adds a complete star system located south of the core worlds, featuring a yellow star, a barren world, a terran paradise, a toxic ore-rich world, and an icy gas giant. Includes a gate, Domain-era devices, and an abandoned pet station for storage. Designed to be compatible with random core worlds and avoid planet overlaps.
